resources.string: Draw without replacement from a fixed pile. Only the main deck supplies the initial pile size; other boards are excluded. Set the matching-card count yourself. This calculator does not simulate mulligans or play rules and never edits your deck.
Use whole numbers: pile size 0–1,000,000, matching cards 0–pile size, and cards drawn 0–1,000 and no more than the pile size.
Percentages are rounded to six decimal places. Counts are calculated exactly.
